description: This header declares the creation function for a CvdCommandHandler responsible for 'remove' commands within the Cuttlefish project's command-line interface. It includes standard and project-specific headers, and defines a factory function with a unique pointer return type.

methods.name: NewRemoveCvdCommandHandler
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler configured for 'remove' commands, utilizing an InstanceManager reference.
